# Scene stills

## Generate scene stills

After implementing each scene, export representative frames directly from Remotion.

Capture:
- Initial composition.
- Main storytelling composition.
- Significant intermediate animation states.
- Final composition.
- Important transition frames.

Use the target production resolution and aspect ratio.

Automate frame extraction so results are reproducible and can be regenerated after revisions.

Start with the first scene and complete the first scene before moving on. Part of completion is getting it past AI inspection and then getting it past human inspection. Once we've gotten it past AI and Human Inspection, we'll have a list of things that we've learned, and we'll apply that to the future scenes. But scenes will need to be accepted one at a time, because it takes a lot to make them, and we don't want to overmake a bunch of scenes when they haven't been critiqued, or when we could have learned a bunch of information from the previous scene, if we would have waited.

## From "Plan all scenes and transitions before coding" (what each scene's stills show)

Initial visual state.
Final visual state.
Transition into the next scene.
